attribute_information.RH: Relative humidity measured in the housing environment during sampling.
attribute_information.THI: Temperature humidity index value reported or calculated for the sampling condition.
attribute_information.Ta: Ambient air temperature measured in the housing environment during sampling.
attribute_information.age: Age of the bird at the time of measurement, reported in weeks.
attribute_information.bird_obs: Unique identifier for one observation record in the dataset.
attribute_information.breed: Breed or strain reported in the source study, if available.
attribute_information.convection: Heat lost by convection, reported or estimated for the sampling condition.
attribute_information.core_rectal_temp: Core body temperature measured rectally, reported in degrees Celsius.
attribute_information.duration: Time spent under the treatment condition before the measurement.
attribute_information.evaporative_heat_loss: Heat lost by evaporation (latent heat loss), reported or estimated for the sampling condition.
attribute_information.feed_intake: Feed intake reported for the bird or group, usually per day.
attribute_information.heat_loss: Total heat loss from the bird, reported or estimated for the sampling condition.
attribute_information.heat_prod: Heat produced by the bird from metabolism, reported or estimated for the sampling condition.
attribute_information.heat_stress_level: Categorical heat stress classification for the condition (thermoneutral to severe heat stress).
attribute_information.housing_type: Housing system used in the study (for example, room, chamber, pen), if reported.
attribute_information.light: Light duration or light condition reported for the sampling period.
attribute_information.live_weight: Live body weight of the bird at the time of measurement.
attribute_information.paper_title: Title of the source paper associated with the record.
attribute_information.radiation: Heat lost by radiation, reported or estimated for the sampling condition.
attribute_information.replicate_group: Replicate or experimental unit grouping reported in the source study.
attribute_information.resp_rate: Respiration rate during sampling, reported in breaths per minute.
attribute_information.sex: Sex of the bird as reported in the source study.
attribute_information.skin_temp: Skin or surface temperature measured during sampling, reported in degrees Celsius.
attribute_information.species: Species category standardized across studies (turkey, chicken, domestic fowl, or duck).
attribute_information.study_id: Identifier for the source study or paper from which the record was extracted.
attribute_information.treatment_id: Identifier for the experimental treatment group in the source study.
attribute_information.water_intake: Water intake reported for the bird or group, usually per day.
attribute_information.wind_speed: Air movement or wind speed measured in the housing environment during sampling.

meta.description: This schema describes the variables in a dataset collected from several studies on growing turkeys. The data include information on the housing environment, bird characteristics, body temperature, and heat production and heat loss. Measurements are taken from individual birds over time under normal temperature conditions and during chronic heat stress. The goal of this schema is to clearly explain each variable so the data can be understood, compared across studies, and reused in future research.
meta.name: Turkey Heat Balance Study Parameters
